g.text: U itself has no audit evidence
ticket audits A’s other batch instead.
one vote per root; corrections replace
Distrust spreads only as far as the audit evidence reaches.
Localized example (A also has 2 flags in context Y)
Exploratory (App. B): S2-ID is evaluated under Sybil
and laundering attacks, which move poison outside S’s
audited scopes; its gate uses no contributor identity.
